info.title: HelmIQ API
info.description: Programmatic access to your HelmIQ workspace. Read Contacts, Companies, and Deals; create and update Contacts and Companies (with the write scopes). Authenticate with an API key as a bearer token. All data is scoped to the organization that owns the key.

get.description: Returns a cursor paginated list of contacts, most recently updated first.

post.description: Creates a contact. Requires the write:contacts scope. If a contact with the same email already exists in your organization, the existing contact is returned (HTTP 200) with deduped set to true, never a second row. Pass an optional Idempotency-Key header to make a network retry safe.

200.description: An existing contact matched on email (deduped).

get.description: Returns a single contact by id.

patch.description: Updates fields on a contact in your organization. Requires the write:contacts scope. Only the fields you send are changed. Changing the email keeps the previous address on the contact (no email is ever lost). An id that belongs to another organization returns 404.

get.description: Returns a cursor paginated list of companies, most recently updated first.

post.description: Creates a company. Requires the write:companies scope. Dedup runs first (by domain, then by normalized name). A single existing match is returned (HTTP 200) with deduped set to true. If more than one existing company matches, the request is rejected with 422 rather than guessing. Pass an optional Idempotency-Key header to make a network retry safe.

200.description: An existing company matched on domain or name (deduped).

get.description: Returns a single company by id.

patch.description: Updates fields on a company in your organization. Requires the write:companies scope. Only the fields you send are changed. The API never merges companies: renaming to a name that another company already uses, changing to a domain another company owns, or editing a name a person has locked each return 409. An id that belongs to another organization returns 404.

get.description: Returns a cursor paginated list of deals, most recently updated first.
Returns a single deal by id.
Returns this OpenAPI 3.1 document. This endpoint is public and requires no authentication.

200.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 document for this API.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Use your API key as a bearer token: Authorization: Bearer hk_live_...

IdPathParam.name: id
IdPathParam.description: The unique identifier of the resource.

QParam.name: q
QParam.description: Free text search across the resource name and key fields.

CompanyIdParam.name: companyId
CompanyIdParam.description: Filter results to a single company by its id.

StageParam.name: stage
StageParam.description: Filter deals to a single pipeline stage.

UpdatedSinceParam.name: updatedSince
UpdatedSinceParam.description: Return only rows updated at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp (for incremental sync).

LimitParam.name: limit
LimitParam.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1 to 100).

CursorParam.name: cursor
CursorParam.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Pass the nextCursor value from the previous page.

IdempotencyKeyParam.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyParam.description: Optional. A unique key you generate per create request. A retry with the same key and the same body replays the original response instead of creating a second record. A retry with the same key but a different body returns 409. Keys expire after 24 hours.

Pagination.description: Cursor pagination metadata for a list response.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more rows.

hasMore.description: True when another page is available.

limit.description: The page size that was applied.

ApiError.description: A structured error returned in the response envelope.

type.description: A stable machine readable error code.

message.description: A human readable explanation of the error.

ContactListResponse.description: Envelope for a page of contacts.

CompanyListResponse.description: Envelope for a page of companies.

DealListResponse.description: Envelope for a page of deals.

ErrorResponse.description: Envelope returned when a request fails. data is null and error is populated.

ContactCreate.description: Fields accepted when creating a contact. Provide at least one of email, phone, mobile, firstName, or lastName. Unknown fields are rejected.

ContactUpdate.description: Fields accepted when updating a contact. Provide at least one field. Unknown fields are rejected.

CompanyCreate.description: Fields accepted when creating a company. name is required. Financial fields (revenue, ebitda, aum) are never accepted. Unknown fields are rejected.

CompanyUpdate.description: Fields accepted when updating a company. Provide at least one field. Financial fields (revenue, ebitda, aum) are never accepted. Unknown fields are rejected.

ContactWriteResponse.description: A created or deduped contact. deduped is true when an existing contact was returned instead of creating a new one.

CompanyWriteResponse.description: A created or deduped company. deduped is true when an existing company was returned instead of creating a new one.

UnauthorizedError.description: The API key is missing, malformed, or invalid (invalid_api_key).

error.message: The provided API key is missing or invalid.

ForbiddenError.description: The key is recognized but not permitted: it lacks the required scope (insufficient_scope) or API access is turned off for the organization (api_access_disabled).

error.message: This API key does not have access to this resource.

NotFoundError.description: No resource with the given id exists in your workspace. Soft-deleted (trashed) rows read as not found: the public API never returns or edits records sitting in the trash.

error.message: No resource was found with the given id.

ValidationError.description: The request body failed validation: an unknown field, a bad value, or a companyId that is not in your organization (invalid_request).

ConflictError.description: The write conflicts with existing state: a name or domain another company already uses, a locked company name, or the same Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (conflict / idempotency_conflict).

error.message: Another company already uses that name.

DedupAmbiguousError.description: More than one existing record matches, so the create cannot safely pick one (dedup_ambiguous). Resolve the duplicate in-app, or update a specific record by id.

error.message: More than one existing company matches. Resolve the duplicate in-app, or PATCH a specific company by id.

RateLimitError.description: The rate limit has been exceeded (rate_limited). Inspect the rate limit headers and retry after the window resets.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: The request quota for the current window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix epoch seconds at which the current window resets.

error.message: Rate limit exceeded. Please retry after the window resets.

InternalError.description: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

error.message: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
